technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring's reactive programming model to integrate the RxJava module for flexibility.
Implement ACLs using Spring Security with a custom permission evaluator for resource-level access control.
Leverage Hadoop's HDFS client API for storing and retrieving uber-jars with HA support.
Use Spark's JobProgressListener and SparkContext APIs to implement job cancellation functionality.
Design configuration overrides for HDFS and YARN using Spring's @Value and environment abstraction.
Profile application startup using Java Flight Recorder and async-profiler to identify CPU bottlenecks.
assumptions: The development team has prior experience with Spring Framework, Hadoop, and Spark ecosystems.
Existing infrastructure supports HDFS and YARN configurations for deployment.
Profiling tools (e.g., JFR, async-profiler) are available for performance analysis.
DSL and UI components for ACLs are out of scope for this increment, as per the spike.
Uber-jar storage in HDFS will use a predefined directory structure with HA-enabled HDFS clusters.
Spark job cancellation will be implemented via REST API or programmatic SparkContext calls.

activities.activity_name: Research and Design for RxJava Module
activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements for a flexible RxJava module, design integration with Spring's reactive stack, and define interfaces for processor usage.
Develop the RxJava module with Spring integration, write unit tests, and validate processor functionality.
Review customer use cases, identify best practices for XD runtime, and draft design specs for ACL implementation.
Develop ACL logic using Spring Security, including resource-level permissions and privilege definitions.
Document design decisions, scope for DSL/UI, and phased implementation plan for ACLs.
Profile admin and container servers to identify CPU bottlenecks during startup, analyze root causes.
Summarize profiling results, document reasons for bottlenecks, and list pros/cons of mitigation strategies.

activities.activity_name: Implement and Test HDFS Storage for Uber-Jars
activities.activity_description: Add HDFS integration for storing/retrieving custom module uber-jars with HA support, including configuration and error handling.

activities.activity_name: Implement and Test HDFS/YARN Config Overrides
activities.activity_description: Add configuration options to override HDFS and YARN locations for uber-jar storage and retrieval.

activities.activity_name: Implement and Test Spark Job Stop Feature
activities.activity_description: Develop functionality to stop existing Spark jobs programmatically, including REST API integration and resource cleanup.
